decisions.reason: As a broad dietary-supplement line close to the firm’s existing offer, it is a low-cost option to keep while market acceptance is still being learned.
The skin-and-hair supplement fits the consumer-health portfolio and, with only early launch information, its uncertainty still supports keeping the option open.
The joint-health supplement extends the established range and is inexpensive to continue relative to the value of waiting for clearer sales evidence.
This mushroom-based immune supplement looks more niche and less prominently supported, but its proximity to the existing range still makes retention worthwhile for now.
The generic blood-pressure product has an early quality/problem signal and is costlier and more regulation-intensive to carry, so the option appears to have resolved unfavorably.
